title: Dashboard
headcountAgeNote: Headcount and average full age at the end of each year's selected period. Former employees are included in years when they were active. Employees without a birth date are excluded from the average.
averageAgeNote: Average full age of employees active at the end of each year's selected period. Former employees are included in years when they were active. Employees without a birth date are excluded from the average.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the dashboard.
invalidReferenceDate: Select a valid reference date on or before today.
referenceDateMismatch: The server returned a different reference date. Your selection has been kept. Please retry.
saveFailed: Unable to save selections. Your selections have been kept. Please retry.
restoreFailed: Unable to restore your previous selections. Please retry.
ytd: From the start of the reference year to the reference date
ageNote: Employees who were active for at least one day in the selected period are counted. Ages are calculated at the end of the period.
genderNote: Employees who were active for at least one day in the selected period are counted, including unspecified gender.
trendNote: Headcount at the end of each year’s selected period. The reference month is counted through the reference date.
formula: Turnover rate = departures in each year’s selected period ÷ employees at the start of that period × 100. A zero denominator is not calculable.
summaryFormula: Turnover rate = departures from January 1 through the reference date ÷ employees on January 1 of the reference year × 100.
pdfError: Unable to download the PDF. Please try again.
referenceDateHelp: Each analysis indicator that uses the reference date is calculated as of this date or for the period from January 1 of that year through this date. The end month cannot be later than the month containing the reference date. If the end month is the same month, charts include data only through this date. Moving this date earlier adjusts any later selected months.
fromMonthHelp: All charts share this start month. The selected period begins on the first day of this month. Choose a month on or before the end month. The calculation periods for analysis indicators that use the reference date remain unchanged.
toMonthHelp: All charts share this end month. The selected period ends on the last day of this month, or on the reference date if it falls in the same month. Choose a month on or after the start month and no later than the reference month. Ages are calculated at the end of the selected period.
invalidMonth: Enter both months in YYYY-MM format.
reversedPeriod: The end month must be on or after the start month.
futureMonth: Months after the reference date cannot be selected.
limitation: Figures are reconstructed from the current hire and retirement dates of employees that have not been deleted. Deleted records and previous employment periods are excluded. Employment ends on the retirement date.
